name: Yellow Sands Cottages
accommodation: Six self-catering cottages with one to three bedrooms, open all year
suitableFor: Couples, families and small groups wanting self-catering close to the sand
beachAccess: Within about 250 metres of Harlyn Bay, with a garden path leading to the dunes and the centre of the bay
confirmedFeatures: Parking, sea views, WiFi, ground-floor bedrooms, garden path to the dunes, open all year
overview: A small group of six self-catering cottages set just back from Harlyn Bay, with a garden path that leads straight onto the dunes. The cottages range from one to three bedrooms and are open all year. Padstow is about two and a half miles away, and the Trevose and St Enodoc golf courses are both close by.
surfTripFit: You can walk to the dunes and the surf in a few minutes, so checking conditions and getting in early is easy.
